messages.subject: hung up on compilation of .hpp/_def.hpp/_inst.cpp
parts:
I added some code to

gm/grammars/expression_grammar_def.hpp

that prints a warning if the user attempts to
divide two integer expressions. This all works,
but what I can't manage to do is print the
actual expressions being used.

There's a function generate_expression() inside
of

gm/generator.hpp

that does what I need.

I have commented out the expression print because I can't
figure out how to get it to compile and link in the test
for expression_grammar_def.

What's odd (to me at least) is that bin/stanc compiles
just fine and everything does what I expect.

Could someone who actually understands C++ builds
factored into headers and code fix this so that it
prints? I pasted (and commented out) the type
signature being used. I have a feeling it's just
not finding the object code for gm::generate_expression()
to link against. But I'm too afraid of our makefiles
to want to mess with them.
